territories.name: Cabo Verde
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Cabo Verde levies a value added tax of its own under the Código do Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (Lei n.º 21/VI/2003, republished by Lei n.º 51/VIII/2013): article 17 sets it at 15 per cent, articles 9 and 13 exempt the operations they list, and article 37 has the taxable person file the return every month.
